params.description: If passed, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is passed) or Variable/Field reference (if * is omitted).

discriminatedBy.rule: Text (an object name) when the leading * is passed; Variable passed directly when * is omitted.

constraints: Returns the context object previously set with WA SET CONTEXT for this Web area, or null if none was defined.
